title: Reduced effective resolution from averaging attention weights
description: Self-attention averages attention-weighted positions, which reduces effective resolution. The paper acknowledges this as a cost of using attention and counteracts it with multi-head attention.
canonical_description: attention averaging reduces effective resolution of representations

evidence.anchor: cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section~[REF:sec:attention].
